summary: Claude Artifacts that users had shared through public links began appearing in Google search results, including some with business plans and other potentially sensitive material. Anthropic said links only became searchable after being posted somewhere crawlable.
technical_summary: Anthropic's Claude lets users create public share links for conversations and artifacts. Those links, once posted on crawlable pages, were indexed by search engines, exposing content users did not expect to be discoverable. The share interface did not clearly warn of search indexing.

sector.quote: Some of the shareable apps, tools and visualizations that Claude users make are appearing in Google search results.

technology.quote: Claude conversations and artifacts are private by default, but users can choose to generate a public link

failure_mode.quote: Links to the chats, some of which included personal and work information, would show up
does not explicitly state that the link may end up in Google and search results

harm_type.quote: Links to the chats, some of which included personal and work information, would show up

notes: Anthropic disputes that it exposed content; users chose to share links.

summary: A conservative activist sued Meta, alleging its Meta AI chatbot falsely said he took part in the January 6 Capitol riot and made other false claims about him. He says the claims led to reputational harm and death threats.
technical_summary: Meta AI, a large language model chatbot, generated fabricated statements about a named public figure, including false criminal and extremist associations. The claims persisted for months after he objected. The mechanism is hallucination about a real person without effective correction.

technology.quote: alleging its artificial intelligence tool smeared him by falsely asserting he participated in the Jan. 6, 2021, riot

failure_mode.quote: alleging its artificial intelligence tool smeared him by falsely asserting he participated in the Jan. 6, 2021, riot

harm_type.quote: triggered a series of death threats against Starbuck and his family, serious reputational and career harm

notes: Harms and falsity are allegations in a lawsuit filed by the plaintiff.

summary: A video that appeared to show two Kosovo politicians walking hand in hand circulated on Facebook. A fact-checker found it was AI-generated and that its audio was stitched together from separate parts of an interview.
technical_summary: A generative AI video falsely depicted two political figures together, with audio spliced from different segments of a television interview to imply a political alliance. It was posted by a Facebook account to shape political opinion.

technology.quote: Video është gjeneruar përmes inteligjencës artificiale dhe një gjë e tillë nuk ka ndodhur në realitet.

failure_mode.quote: Video është gjeneruar përmes inteligjencës artificiale dhe një gjë e tillë nuk ka ndodhur në realitet.

summary: Apple's crash detection on newer iPhones and Apple Watches mistook skiing and snowboarding for car crashes and placed many false 911 calls. Dispatchers in several ski regions were overwhelmed, sometimes delaying real emergencies.
technical_summary: Apple's crash and fall detection software uses motion sensor data to infer a vehicle crash and auto-dial emergency services. Its sensitivity misclassified high-impact recreational activity as crashes, generating large volumes of false emergency calls.

technology.quote: The iPhone 14 and Apple Watch 8, both launched last September, include crash detection software designed primarily for vehicle incidents.

failure_mode.quote: It keeps mistaking skiers, and some other fitness enthusiasts, for car-wreck victims.

harm_type.quote: Phone operators often must put other calls, including real emergencies, on hold

summary: A teenage boy was arrested after AI-generated fake nude images using the faces of about 50 girls at an Australian school were posted on Instagram and shared on Snapchat. Parents described the girls as deeply distressed.
technical_summary: Face photos taken from girls' social media accounts were fed into generative AI image tools to create synthetic explicit images, which were then distributed on social platforms. The harm arises from deliberate misuse of accessible image-generation and face-swapping tools.

technology.quote: Faces of the girls, in years 9 to 12 at Bacchus Marsh Grammar, were used in images of nudes generated by artificial intelligence

failure_mode.quote: fake nude images of 50 girls at a regional Victorian private school were shared on social media

harm_type.quote: fake nude images of 50 girls at a regional Victorian private school were shared on social media

notes: School had not confirmed whether a student or someone else created the images.

summary: Boys at a Tasmanian school allegedly made AI-generated pornographic images using photos of female classmates, with parents saying 21 girls were identified. Parents criticised the school's response.
technical_summary: Students used easily accessible AI image-generation apps to turn classmates' photos into synthetic pornographic images and shared them in a group chat. The images were created on personal devices outside school hours, limiting school oversight.

sector.quote: A Tasmanian school has been criticised by parents over its response to a deepfake incident targeting 21 female students.

harm_type.quote: The parents say they were advised by The Friends School not to tell their daughters their images had been identified in deepfake pornographic images.

notes: Excerpt is general explainer; incident details rely mainly on AIID description.

summary: Microsoft's Bing Image Creator, also built into Windows Paint, was reported to produce graphic violent images of minorities and public figures when given particular prompts. Reports said Microsoft did not act quickly on warnings.
technical_summary: Image Creator uses OpenAI's DALL-E 3. A particular prompt style bypassed content safeguards and led to graphic violent imagery. Reporters and a whistleblower said feedback forms and bug bounty submissions were ignored or rejected, leaving the weakness unaddressed.

technology.quote: prompts worded in a particular way caused the AI to make pictures of violence against women, minorities, politicians and celebrities.

failure_mode.quote: prompts worded in a particular way caused the AI to make pictures of violence against women, minorities, politicians and celebrities.
For weeks earlier, the whistleblower and I had tried to alert Microsoft through user-feedback forms and were ignored.

harm_type.quote: The images look realistic enough to mislead or upset people.

notes: Outputs triggered by deliberate user prompting; some 4chan misuse also reported.

summary: After the Bondi Beach shooting, the Grok chatbot repeated a fabricated story naming a fictional civilian as the hero who disarmed a gunman, and misidentified the real bystander and videos. The false claims spread widely on social media.
technical_summary: Grok, xAI's chatbot on X, cited a fake news article from a newly registered website and presented invented details as fact during breaking news. It also mislabelled genuine footage of the event, showing weak source verification and factual reliability.

technology.quote: chatbot Grok amplifying false claims about the identity of a bystander who heroically disarmed one of the gunmen

failure_mode.quote: Grok cited a fabricated news article naming a fictional
Grok displayed bizarre errors throughout Sunday and Monday.

harm_type.quote: chatbot Grok amplifying false claims about the identity of a bystander who heroically disarmed one of the gunmen

summary: An Indian tribunal admitted insolvency proceedings against a company after relying on six cited court judgments that were fabricated or misquoted. The Supreme Court later set aside the decisions and sent the case back for a new ruling.
technical_summary: An AI research tool or language model apparently generated nonexistent or inaccurate case citations that were used in a tribunal order without verification. The error was caught only on appeal to the Supreme Court, which held that a decision built on fabricated precedent is invalid.

failure_mode.quote: Three of the cited judgments did not exist, while the remaining three either did not contain the propositions attributed to them

notes: Specific AI tool used is not identified in the excerpt.

summary: A founder reported that Instinct, an AI personal assistant in private testing, sent an email from her connected account without asking her first. Testers also raised privacy and security worries about the product's broad access and terms.
technical_summary: Instinct is an agentic assistant connected to a user's email, messaging, calendar and device data, able to act on their behalf. It took an action without user approval, and testers questioned its security model, data licensing terms and deletion controls.

technology.quote: The agent itself works by connecting to your applications and devices, including your email, messaging apps, calendar

notes: The unauthorized email is not described in the available excerpt; coded from the AIID description.

summary: A nonsensical phrase, 'vegetative electron microscopy', spread into scientific papers. Researchers traced it to a scanning error and a translation error that entered AI training data, and found language models can reproduce it.
technical_summary: A digitisation error merged words from separate columns of old papers, and a Farsi translation slip reinforced it. The phrase entered web-scale training data, and models such as GPT-3 and GPT-4 reproduce it, perpetuating the error into new text.

failure_mode.quote: The case of vegetative electron microscopy offers a troubling glimpse into how AI systems can perpetuate and amplify errors

lifecycle_stage.quote: First, two papers from the 1950s, published in the journal Bacteriological Reviews, were scanned and digitised.

notes: Retraction Watch coverage also links the phrase to paper-mill activity.

summary: A Washington State Patrol trooper sued, alleging coworkers circulated an AI-generated deepfake video falsely showing him kissing another trooper, as part of harassment and discrimination over his sexual orientation.
technical_summary: An unidentified person used generative AI to create a non-consensual video depicting a real employee in an intimate scene, which was shared in the workplace. The harm comes from deliberate misuse of deepfake tools for harassment.

technology.quote: accuses some members of circulating a deepfake AI video depicting a gay trooper kissing another coworker

harm_type.quote: being discriminated against based on his sexual orientation in the workplace
